sentences.text:
Shambhu Nath Karikar vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 6
January, 2026
Author: Suvra Ghosh

Bench: Suvra Ghosh
January 6, 2026
(13) Ardr
 Wpa 25835 of 2023
 Can 1 of 2025
 Shambhu Nath Karikar
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & ors.
 Adv. Sourav Mondal,
 ... for the petitioner.
 Adv. Niladri Sekhar Ghosh,
 Adv. Labanio Sikder,
 Adv. Sourik Dey,
 ....for the intervenor.

Sr. Adv. Tapan Kumar Mukherjee,
 Adv. Sangeeta Roy,
 Adv. Somnath Naskar,
 ...for the State.

The applicants seek to be added as party
 respondents in the writ petition on the ground that they
are also victims of the alleged fraud and stand on the same footing as the petitioner.
The petitioner does not deny the said fact.
The application being CAN 1 of 2025 is allowed on consent.
The applicants be added as proforma respondents in the writ petition.
The cause title of the writ petition be amended accordingly.
Re : WPA 25835 of 2023 Report submitted by the State is taken on record.

The petitioner and the proforma respondents seek reinvestigation of the case and addition of appropriate provisions of the Information Technology Act and the West Bengal Protection of Interest of the Depositors in Financial Establishments Act.
This Court is informed that the charge sheet has been submitted under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

In order to deal with the prayer of the petitioner and the proforma respondents the Case Shambhu Nath Karikar vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119519435/
